paragraphs.text: Trijiro was a centaur zuriv (shaman-chief) of Vor Golozar 's tribe on Ravnica .

He often wandered to the Utvara township under the disguise of a beggar, to contact Agrus Kos and profit from mutual exchange of information. He ordered Vor Golozar to accompany the goblin messenger Crix to Cauldron after her capture. His fate is uncertain, but he was presumably slain by the taj under the control of Melisk , together with all inhabitants of their village.
